name: Agent Queue Inspector
blurb: queued work by time, room and success rate, with the stuck step
intro: One look at the agents' work: notes queued per room and how long they have waited, what each room is running, how its runs have gone (from the start/finish lines in its log), and - for a run that has gone quiet longer than the threshold - the step it stopped at. In the app it reads the live queue, runs and logs; the numbers are worked out from that snapshot only.

inputs.label: Stuck after
inputs.help: A running room with no log line for this long counts as stuck.

examples.title: A quiet CAD run and a waiting web note

usage: Pass `snapshot` as JSON {at: ISO time of the snapshot, queue: [{id, kind, summary, queued_at}], runs: {room: {status, percent, title, started_at, finished_at}}, activity: {room: [{at, text, level}]}, revisions: [{kind, status}]} - the app's /api/queue, /api/run?room=, /api/activity?room= and /api/revisions - plus `stuck` in minutes and optionally one `room`. It returns per room the queue length and oldest wait, the current run and its time, runs ok from the log's started/finished lines, error lines and the applied rate; stuck runs with the last step logged; and the queue sorted by wait. Use it when work seems not to move, to find which room and which step to look at.
sources: Stuck = no log line for longer than a threshold: rule of thumb (a heartbeat timeout)
